name: gizza-ai/audio-fade
summary: Add a fade-in and fade-out to an audio file

tool.description: Add a smooth fade-in at the start and/or fade-out at the end of an audio file. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). fade_in and fade_out are lengths in seconds (0-30, both default 3); set one to 0 to fade only the other side — both at 0 is rejected. Fades longer than the track just fade across the whole file. Output is re-encoded to mp3 (192 kbps), wav, ogg, flac or m4a; embedded album art is dropped.

fade_in.description: Fade-in length in seconds at the start (0-30, default 3). 0 skips the fade-in.

fade_out.description: Fade-out length in seconds at the end (0-30, default 3). 0 skips the fade-out.

format.description: Output audio format. Default mp3 (192 kbps).

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Audio URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
